text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, after our whirlwind days racing through the Twinkle Series had reached a brief lull.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um... Would you go on a hot springs trip
with me, please?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A hot spring trip... Could it be that she wants to use
the hot spring vacation ticket she won in the lottery?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"O-Of course you'd say that! Sorry.
...I was just hoping to go with the person I'm most grateful to."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
When I thought about it, I couldn't think of anyone else besides you, Trainer...
Ah, but if you don't want to, please feel free to turn me down!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Of course, it's not that I dislike it... And since they asked so nicely, it'd be rude not to go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Wah! So much steam! It's the quintessential hot spring town~!
The onsen manju smell great too...! Later, we should—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“—Oh dear! My apologies,
even though today is supposed to be about treating you.”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
This trip is all about showing my gratitude, after all!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I did my prep work too,
so just tell me where you want to go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She looked quite fired up.
Since she offered, I decided to take advantage of her generosity. However—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Business is booming, huh.
This soba shop, I mean..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“...... N-Not yet?
I'll go check things out real quick!”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
Is the pottery class closed today?

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yes, on short notice. I'm sorry.
The kiln's acting up, so it's currently being repaired.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, gotcha...!
I see, sorry to interrupt while you're busy.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "Under Repair: Do Not Enter"... Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everywhere I went,
one piece of bad luck hit me after another...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ………………I'm so sorry!
choice_data_list: No, no, Shion, you're not in the wrong.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Still... we really should've decided where to go
ahead of time after all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(It's not like I didn't think
maybe I ought to decide, but—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...Huh? Come to think of it,
what kind of things does Trainer actually like?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Come to think of it... I don't really know their favorite foods or hobbies.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (What should I do, should I ask them to pick beforehand? But they're taking time out of their busy schedule to come, I shouldn't burden them with that...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (B-But, still... wh-what do I doooo?!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (In the end, I just ended up thinking I'd study the pamphlet enough to handle anything that comes up on the day...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Win Variation is completely disheartened... but in the first place, I was the one who chose this location.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I am simply happy that you invited me.
There is no need to go out of your way to entertain me, though—
choice_data_list: (I'd hate to let all that enthusiasm go to waste, though...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was there something she did during the Twinkle Series
that made me particularly happy?
Aside from the races—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: U-Um, well... I was watching footage of Orfe-san's past races, and...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I got so nervous I couldn't sleep...
I'm so sorry... for not getting enough rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Could it be that Win Variation has started opening up and speaking honestly about her feelings?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Then I want to know your honest feelings.
Then I want to know your honest feelings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was what made me the happiest.
So please, tell me honestly where you want to go
and what you want to do right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was what made me the happiest.
So please, tell me honestly where you want to go
and what you want to do right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because that's surely what would make them happiest.
When I explain it like that—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh...—
I-Is that so? There's no way, that's just—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Wah... I really am blessed, aren't I?
Thank you, so much...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um, honest feelings, right!
Ummm... let's see...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ......C-Can I really be completely honest?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Then, umm...
...I'm getting chilly, so I'd like to hit the hot springs."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "And so, after that... I want to eat onsen manju together with you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: A-And with that, thank you for the food!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...!
So delicious!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It's sweeter than I thought,
and hehe, it's pretty hot too.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
…………
...It tastes like happiness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond between Win Variation and myself...
